Products & Services
Empowering the Future: Academic Excellence, Support Services & Innovation
At
Srikishan Sarda College
we are committed to delivering a holistic educational experience that extends far beyond the classroom. Our programs are designed to empower students with the knowledge, skills, and support they need to thrive in today's competitive world.
🎓 Academic Programs
We offer a diverse range of undergraduate programs across various disciplines:
Bachelor of Arts (Pass and Honours) (FYUG under Assam University, Silchar)
English, History, Political Science, Bengali, Economics, Philosophy, Manipuri, Sanskrit, Persian
Bachelor of Science (Pass and Honours), (FYUG under Assam University, Silchar)
Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany & Statistics
Bachelor of Commerce (Pass and Honours) (FYUG under Assam University, Silchar)
General, Accounting & Finance,
Senior Secondary (Arts) ( Under Assam State School Education Board (Div II)
English, History, Political Science, Bengali, Economics, Philosophy, Manipuri, Sanskrit, Persian
Senior Secondary (Science) ( Under Assam State School Education Board (Div II)
Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany & Statistics
Senior Secondary (Commerce) ( Under Assam State School Education Board (Div II)
Each program is structured with a blend of theoretical foundations and practical exposure.
🧑‍🏫 Teaching & Learning Services
Experienced Faculty:
Qualified and passionate educators dedicated to student growth.
Smart Classrooms:
Tech-enabled learning spaces to enhance classroom experiences.
Laboratories & Research Facilities:
Advanced labs for hands-on experimentation and innovation.
E-Learning Resources:
Access to digital libraries, e-books, online journals, etc.
🧭 Student Support Services
Academic Counselling:
Personalized guidance for course selection and career planning.
Career Services:
Internship and placement support with industry partnerships.
Student Mentorship:
Faculty and peer mentorship programs for continuous support.
Mental Health & Wellness:
On-campus counselling and wellness workshops.
🌐 Campus Facilities
Library:
A rich collection of academic and recreational reading material.
Computer Labs:
High-speed internet and software tools for academic use.
Hostel Accommodation:
Safe and comfortable living spaces for outstation students.
Cafeteria & Dining:
Healthy and hygienic food options on campus.
Sports & Recreation:
Grounds, gymnasium, etc for overall development.
🤝 Value-Added Services
Skill Development Workshops:
Resume writing, interview skills, coding bootcamps, etc are conducted under finishing school program of RUSA, Assam
Certifications & Add-on Courses:
Add on courses are offered by different departments of the college
Entrepreneurship Cell:
Support for start-up ideas and innovation.
Social Outreach & Volunteering:
Opportunities to engage with the community.
